name: Seret
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Seret is mentioned in 1 Chronicles as a son of Ashhur and his wife Helah. He belongs to the tribe of Judah and is part of the genealogies connecting the patriarchs with later generations in Israel. Little is known about him beyond his place in the family tree.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Judah
keyEvents.description: Seret is listed as a son of Ashhur and Helah in the tribal genealogy of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Ashhur
keyEvents.description: Ashhur, father of Tekoa, had two wives, Helah and Naarah, and Seret was among the sons of Helah.

keyEvents.title: Genealogical line of the tribe of Judah
keyEvents.description: Seret is part of the broader genealogical line of the tribe of Judah, which is important for tracing Israel's heritage and land allocation.

keyEvents.title: Tekoa's Founding Family
keyEvents.description: Through his father Ashhur, who is considered the father of Tekoa, Serah is connected to the founding of the city of Tekoa.
